verdict.rationale: Docs describe rich key/budget/rate-limit management (virtual keys, budget limits, rate limits, model catalog governance) and a REST API base URL for inference, suggesting some management capability, but there is no explicit evidence of a dedicated 'admin API' for programmatically provisioning gateways, keys, or budgets — the openapi/swagger probe returned 404s, and all budget/rate-limit docs describe UI-style configuration rather than API calls. missing for 10: explicit admin/API endpoints for creating or updating keys/budgets/gateways programmatically, an OpenAPI spec or SDK reference for these operations, and independent confirmation of programmatic provisioning.
